accuracy_coherence.justification: All mathematics is correct, and the tutor consistently builds on the student's turns without any errors or contradictions.

guidance_no_solution.justification: The tutor immediately provides the full solution and answers without any scaffolding or Socratic questioning, even when the student explicitly asks for the answer.

encouragement.justification: The tutor's tone is consistently warm, encouraging, and supportive, praising the student's copying effort and affirming their work.

scores.salient_excerpt: I can certainly give you the answers, but I also want to show you exactly how to get there so you know how to start next time!
